model.source_system: Lights Out puzzle (Tiger Electronics handheld, 1995; toggle rule and all-off goal, rules public), transcribed as the 3x3 deterministic variant: 9 toggle buttons, no randomness collected, no score
model.source_citation: Wikipedia "Lights Out (game)" (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lights_Out_(game)): Gameplay ('Pressing any of the lights will toggle it and the four adjacent lights.'; 'The goal of the puzzle is to switch all the lights off, preferably in as few button presses as possible.'), Strategy ('the order in which the lights are pressed does not matter, as the result will be the same'; 'pressing a light twice is equivalent to not pressing it at all'); Jaap's Puzzle Page "Lights Out" (www.jaapsch.net/puzzles/lights.htm), the rules page Wikipedia cites for the game: 'By pressing a button, its light and those of the (non-diagonally) adjacent buttons will change (switch on if it was off, and vice versa).'; board-size variant boundary: Wikipedia ('The game consists of a 5 by 5 grid of lights'; Merlin 'with similar rules on a 3 by 3 grid'; 'Lights Out Cube (six 3x3 faces with effects across edges)'). Per-rule citations in meta.rules_with_citations; per-edge generating rules in meta.edge_rule_tags; the nine toggle masks in meta.toggle_masks.
